title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1980-05-16
lineage: 2 x Nakamichi CM700 w/ EQ 26th Row Center> Sony TC-D5 (dolby encode) Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi DR-1 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96] > ? > flac16; Taped by: Barry Glassberg
source: Source: FOB Audience Recording Media: MAC = Maxell UDXLII;

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with strong bass; show mixes high points like High Time and Brokedown Palace with slower, sleepy moments.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a top‑of‑the‑line audience sound with unusually clear bass and overall excellent fidelity. Musically the concert delivers standout moments – High Time, Row Jimmy, The Dew (rare) and a beloved encore of Brokedown Palace – but several of Jerry’s numbers feel overly slow and The Dew comes across as sleepy for some listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers praise the recording quality (excellent) but diverge on performance, giving one a perfect score and the other a middling 3‑star rating; weighted average yields a solid 3.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bass is punchy and clearer than typical audience tapes; overall clarity is high with no reported drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set includes several fan‑favorite sweet songs and a strong encore, but the pacing feels uneven with some overly slow tempos that dampen momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sweet tone praised, but many of his tunes are described as too slow.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as unusually strong and prominent.
